card.name: Unit or digits right after a dose number
card.fires_on: The unit or last digit of a dose amount, such as mg or mcg, right after a number in dosing instructions. It also fires on the final digit of a number like 60 or 5600.

modes.label: Unit after dose number
modes.description: The unit (mg, mcg) comes right after a number in a starting-dose or injection schedule.

modes.label: Digit inside a dose number
modes.description: A digit or unit piece inside a multi-digit dose amount.
